record_title: Sharp certification boundary for Lanczos-based proximal convexification
provenance: Scientific record analyzing the spectral certification required by a Lanczos-based proximal convexification rule for indefinite quadratic programming.
limitations: The counterexample targets the published rule under the standard finite-step Rayleigh--Ritz interpretation of the Lanczos estimate. It does not establish failure of benchmark runs or of an implementation that may use an undocumented certified lower spectral bound. The delta>2 threshold is for the restricted information model of an arbitrary Ritz value plus the infinity-norm bound.
